mapper.select: select * from 0721acgn.tb_animation where hengpic is not null order by RAND() LIMIT 6

SELECT id, name, shortcomment, longcomment, rating, releasedate, status, bcimg, preview_video_url AS previewVideoUrl, countpage, voicer, hengpic, genre, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM 0721acgn.tb_animation WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, animation_id AS animationId, episode_no AS episodeNo, title, video_url AS videoUrl, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM 0721acgn.tb_animation_episode WHERE animation_id = #{animationId} ORDER BY episode_no ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, animation_id AS animationId, episode_no AS episodeNo, title, video_url AS videoUrl, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM 0721acgn.tb_animation_episode WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO 0721acgn.tb_animation_episode (animation_id, episode_no, title, video_url) VALUES (#{animationId}, #{episodeNo}, #{title}, #{videoUrl}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), video_url = VALUES(video_url), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
